subject: Copywriting
title: Gary Halbert: The Prince of Print
description: A short lesson to help you apply Gary Halbert: The Prince of Print.

hook.text: Gary Halbert mailed 600 million letters over his career.

buildup.text: Halbert wrote from prison after a mail fraud conviction. His prison letters became legendary copywriting lessons.

discovery.text: His 'Boron Letters' to his son taught raw, honest copywriting. Written with nothing but time and a pen.

twist.text: Halbert's most important advice wasn't about copy—it was about lists. 'A starving crowd' beats great copy every time.

climax.text: He lived larger than life and died leaving a cult-like following of direct-response copywriters who still study him.

punchline.text: A starving crowd beats great copy. Find the hunger first.

quiz.question: What did Halbert say was more important than great copy?
